title.narrative: CultureCIVIC ''Promoting tolerance, dialogue and freedom of expression"

description.narrative: Global Objective: To support cultural CSOs to implement initiatives that promote tolerance, dialogue, non-discrimination, freedom of expression, social cohesion, promotion of individual liberties, and democratic processes in Turkey. CultureCIVIC will achieve this objective by supporting cultural CSOs, operators, artists and activists through a grant program and through capacity building, also focusing on the development of networks and dialogue between these actors.
